name: Macaco
summary: Macaco is a fast-paced and energetic Gorilla Tag fan game that drops players into wild, jungle-themed environments filled with trees, ruins, and cliffs. Play as a mischievous monkey and use advanced VR locomotion to run, climb, swing, and launch yourself through vibrant, stylized worlds. Inspired by the movement style of Gorilla Tag, Macaco expands on the formula with new game modes, unique maps, and community-driven features that keep the gameplay fresh and chaotic.
